row.evidence: ImageKit's SSO is "available only on custom enterprise pricing plans" and "uses SAML-based authentication for 'Just In Time' (JIT) provisioning"; users deleted in the IdP still "exist on ImageKit and count towards your subscription plan".
row.notes: New in 2026-09. No SCIM endpoint anywhere in the docs; the only automation is SAML JIT (create and update name/role on sign-in) on Enterprise (Contact Sales), so status is none per rule 2 (fallbacks.jit true). Deprovisioning is manual: IdP-deleted users keep their seat until an admin deletes them in User Management. Plans are flat monthly prices with fixed user caps (Free 2, Lite 3, Pro 5 then $9/user), so per-user fields are null. SSO setup uses custom SAML apps in Okta, Entra (non-gallery) and OneLogin, not catalogue apps. The public REST API covers media, files, cache and account usage only; no user-management endpoints.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Central audit logs are viewed in the dashboard; no audit-log API is documented.

scim.notes: No SCIM in the docs index (llms.txt) or OpenAPI spec; SSO is SAML with JIT only. false is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: The REST API (HTTP Basic with the private key) covers upload, DAM, file metadata, custom metadata, cache purge and account usage/origins/URL endpoints. No user, group or role endpoints in the API overview or the v1 OpenAPI spec. Central audit logs (Enterprise) are viewed in the dashboard only.

okta.notes: ImageKit's guide builds a custom SAML 2.0 app via Create App Integration; no OIN app found (okta.com/integrations/imagekit returns 404).

entra.notes: ImageKit's guide uses a Non-gallery application.

onelogin.notes: ImageKit's guide uses the generic SAML Custom Connector (Advanced).

fallbacks.notes: SAML JIT creates the user and updates full name and role (imagekit_role claim) at each sign-in. Users are otherwise added and deleted manually in User Management.
